params.body:
**Triage proposal** (from the forwarded mail; change the labels if it is wrong)
Category: bug  Priority: P3
Summary: One slow HEAD request to the bucket made a partner's vehicle upload through the API fail, and the whole new vehicle was rolled back. It is a one-off (951 store calls in the last five days without another), but the same timeout was already handled elsewhere and not here.

## What happened

On 31 October 2026 at 13:53 the platform sent its automatic "Stocklist Api error" mail for `POST` vehicle store (`VehicleApiController::store`). While adding the first photo, `VehicleApiService::addPhoto` asks the bucket whether `<vehicle>/car_image_<order>.<ext>` already exists. That HEAD request did not answer, Flysystem threw `UnableToCheckExistence`, and the controller's catch deleted the vehicle it had just created and answered the partner with the error message (status 200).

The bucket is intermittently slow (see `App\Support\StorageUnavailable`, introduced for the same symptom in `ProcessImage` in #988). The disk itself retries only once at the SDK level with a 2 s connect timeout, on purpose, so a single slow moment can still surface.

## What should happen

A HEAD that does not answer is asked again once after a short pause, as in `ProcessImage`. If the bucket still does not answer, the upload fails as before (nothing half-written), but with a `StorageUnavailable` naming the real cause.

Source: Portal mail:37.
params.title: A slow bucket HEAD in the partner API photo upload rolls back the whole vehicle
